latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — drafts customer-facing Benefit statements linking product capabilities directly to Explicit Needs after discovery calls, with built-in guardrails.

- Drafts one clear Benefit statement per matched (Explicit Need, product capability) pair for use in proposals, follow-up emails, or demos.
- Refuses to draft Benefits when no Explicit Need is present in the needs log, redirecting to the discovery question planner.
- Flags gaps where customer needs cannot be matched by current product capabilities.
- Enforces separation between Explicit Needs and Implied Needs, preventing premature or misaligned Benefit claims.
- Applies special sub-flow for new product launches, focusing on problem/need identification when no needs log exists.
